name: @gurukul/rules-tests
description: Tests for firebase/firestore.rules and firebase/storage.rules, run against the Firestore and Storage emulators.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-gurukul "vitest run" && node ../../scripts/check-rules-coverage.mjs coverage ../firestore.rules && node ../../scripts/check-rules-coverage.mjs --mutants coverage-storage/storage.json ../storage.rules
